name: VCW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Contested in a tournament on the fed's only surviving card; no champion is named in any document this collection holds.

name: VCW Television Championship
epitaph: Named in the fed's own founding and relaunch paperwork; no champion or title match survives in this collection's holdings.

name: VCW Heavyweight Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Named in the fed's own founding and relaunch paperwork; no champion or title match survives in this collection's holdings.

name: VCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Defended twice on the same New Year's Revolution card, kept by the same champion both times.

name: VCW Western States Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at New Year's Revolution after three prior challenges by the same wrestler had come up short.

name: VCW Ironman Championship
epitaph: A title defense thrown out for interference at VCW Pro and rebooked as a steel-cage blowoff.

name: VCW Women's Championship
epitaph: Held undefeated through eight matches by the same champion, who was left without an opponent when a unification bout fell through.
